title: Dances in Mandeville
summary: Asked about dances across the lake, Foster says there were dances at the Southern Dollars Hall in Mandeville.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Can you tell us anything more about the music over across the lake, before you came over? Oh. Did they have many dances over there? I guess you didn't go to many dances if you were raised there in the church at first.

Yeah, they had dances over there. They had the Southern Dollars Hall, I said that, but they had dances. And this same boy, I'll speak about, I will tell you a little later about that, what it be a tea, you know. Yeah. That's where he used to come and play. That's in Mandelville.
